title: One KestrelCare Plan per Vehicle
content:
**Rule.** A customer may hold KestrelCare Vehicle Service Contracts plans on several vehicles; there is no limit on the number of plans per customer. One vehicle may carry only one plan that is pending or active. A second plan on the same VIN is not sold, and an upgrade means cancelling the existing plan and buying a new one.

**What is counted.** The count is the number of KestrelCare plans on the same VIN whose status is pending or active at the moment of the request, as the service contract records show them. Plans on that VIN that are expired, cancelled, exhausted or transferred are not counted. The VIN of the plan being sold is the VIN the count is taken on; what the customer says about other coverage does not replace the records.

| Plans on the same VIN at the request | A new KestrelCare plan on that VIN |
|---|---|
| none pending or active | may be sold |
| one pending | not sold |
| one active | not sold |

## Cases (hypothetical customers)

- A customer with an active KestrelCare Gold plan on one car buys a second car and asks for KestrelCare Silver on it. The count on the second VIN is zero, so the plan may be sold; the plan on the first car does not limit it.
- A customer whose KestrelCare Powertrain plan on a VIN is still pending asks for KestrelCare Platinum on the same VIN. A second plan is not sold; moving to the higher level means cancelling the Powertrain plan and buying the Platinum plan.
- A VIN whose earlier KestrelCare plan has expired has no pending or active plan, so a new plan on it is not blocked by this rule.
